summary: Empire Builders is a monthly "team mastermind" for real estate agents held in the Learning Lab at the Keller Williams Professionals office at 48 Grove St, Asheville. Listings describe peer hot-seats, goal tracking, and accountability among real estate professionals, but it is brokerage-organized internal programming rather than a self-identified public community, and Eventbrite's own copy sets only a minimum of 2 attendees per session, suggesting open enrollment rather than a fixed roster.

evidence.note: 8 monthly listings Dec 2025-Oct 2026, always free, always at the same KW Professionals office address, tagged 'Team Mastermind', 'Peer Accountability', 'Agent Mastermind'.
Event summaries consistently describe peer hot-seats, goal tracking, and accountability/coaching among real estate professionals rather than an audience passively receiving content.

Eventbrite's own listing text (per a fetch of the page) describes it as 'a mastermind for growth-focused leaders' hosted by Keller Williams Professionals in their 'Learning Lab', requiring only a minimum of 2 attendees per session - consistent with open internal enrollment, not a fixed membership roster.

No Asheville-specific website, Facebook group/page, Meetup, Instagram, news coverage, or agent-team roster for 'Empire Builders' turned up in search; other unrelated programs share the name elsewhere (a KW Legacy ops-manager program in Apex NC, and independent coaching programs by Monica Kline and Honoree Corder), none tied to Asheville.
